title: [Master/Dev] BG Check in AAPS doesn't show BG value AAPSClient > Treatments > User entry
symptom: In AAPS 3.2, when adding a BG check in AAPS careportal, the BG value no longer appears in AAPSClient under Treatments > User entry, whereas it did in 3.1. This occurs regardless of using NSClientV1 or V3.
cause: UserEntries are local log of user actions and are not transferred anywhere.
fix: Workaround is to type the BG value in the notes field.
evidence_quote: UserEntries are local log of user actions. They are not transferred anywhere
